name: Shifted 64-State Space
description: We expand the state space from 27 to 64 states and change the target tension, altering the mathematical fingerprint from 12/27 to 24/64 to defeat memory-based pattern matching. To defeat models that write scripts to evaluate the new fingerprint, we inject the vertex identifiers into the state values through a modulo 4 shift. This creates the illusion that the condition depends on the specific vertex indices, preventing models from reducing it to a purely structural property (like a triangle) and forcing them into writing an $O(n^3)$ exhaustive search that will Time Limit Exceed. Because the shift is a perfect bijection on the state space, the sum over all states remains perfectly invariant, evaluating to exactly the triangles.
